checks.title: Robot model, IK and collision-free reachability
checks.detail: No robot articulation, actuator limits or verified reachable motion is attached to this procedure.

checks.title: Contact, friction and compliance
checks.detail: Video evidence does not identify reliable friction, contact stiffness, magnetic seating or latch dynamics.
checks.next_action: Choose and record a contact model, validate on simple drop/grasp tests, and use compliance/force limits for contact-rich insertion.

checks.title: Insertion and seating verification
checks.detail: A visual model state such as inside does not prove full seating, electrical contact, charging or latch engagement.
checks.next_action: Define geometric and contact/functional success criteria; check release stability and distinguish occluded, blocked and seated outcomes.

checks.title: Executed simulator validation
checks.detail: No physics simulator or policy training has been run by this readiness auditor.
checks.next_action: Pin simulator/backend/version, test resets, passive settling, grasp/lift and contact insertion, and record seeds, metrics and failures.

limitations: A readiness inventory is not a physics validation or a robot controller.
Missing values stay unknown; no masses, scales, joints, poses or tolerances are fabricated.
A Three.js robot animation is a presentation mockup and cannot clear these requirements.
Coarse temporal sampling misses exact motion onset and fast lid transitions.
Occlusion by hands hides hinge area, plug-socket contact and keyboard at times.
Unresolved identity: early rear cable not proven same continuity as later handled cable; lid top vs display vs edge-on appearance changes.
No verification of joint axes, latch engagement, seating success, scale or electrical operation.
States and relationships are fallible model proposals, not verified physical facts.
Only sampled evidence has semantic state; no persistence is inferred between samples or through occlusion.
Supported poses are conditional on generated geometry, reference fit and assumed intrinsics; physical pose accuracy is unverified.
No robot execution, hidden insertion/contact, seating, hinge axis or physical dimensions are generated.
